correctness.rationale: The vertex/edge model is exactly 15 duads plus 15 synthemes with 3-regular 45-edge girth-eight incidence, verified by exhaustive BFS. Independent-set branching and a second bipartite-side binomial count agree on all 476187 faces. Explicit 238089-pair matching covers all but 9 dimension-eight augmented cells; the complete 3,461,430-cover directed Hasse graph topologically sorts all 476187 nodes. Removing the matched empty/vertex pair leaves one vertex and nine eight-cell critical simplices, proving a nine-sphere wedge over the integers by discrete Morse theory.

value.rationale: The Tutte–Coxeter graph is the unique smallest cubic girth-eight cage and a fundamental generalized-quadrangle incidence graph. The exact integral homotopy classification of its independence complex is a natural canonical invariant, not a parameter-adjusted corollary of suspension theory: a complex with 14-dimensional faces collapses to nine eight-spheres. The precise multiplicity and degree provide a nontrivial baseline for further questions on independence homotopy of finite generalized polygons/cages; a full general theorem is neither claimed nor required.
